messages:
sam: Quick design review: prototype for key management with emphasis on explicit actions and undo. Sharing a GIF with flows.

ina: Love the explicit actions. Question: primary action on the row should be 'Details' or 'Copy'? we should avoid accidental clipboard writes.

sam: Proposal: default row click opens details. Copy is an icon button. Reveal secret is a separate flow (dialog).

lee: Agree. Also suggest renaming 'Revoke' to 'Disable' and adding a two-step for permanent delete in advanced. Less panic.

design-bot: Accessibility notes: 1) copy button needs aria-label "Copy key to clipboard"; 2) reveal uses role=dialog with focus trap; 3) toast must not include secret text.

harper: For rotate, ops asked for a confirmation pattern that prevents bulk accidental rotates: show inline 'pending rotation' pill with cancel for 10s before finalizing.

zoe: UX copy for empty state: "No API tokens yet. Create one to get started." CTA "Create token" + small link "How scopes work". add keyboard shortcut hint: C.

sam: Edge-case: bulk disable while some tokens are already pending rotate. We'll show a conflict modal listing affected tokens with checkboxes.

ina: QA checklist: keyboard nav, SR announcement for copy/reveal, focus return after dialog close, undo accessible via keyboard.

sam: Action items: @lee update comps to show copy icon & details-first row, @harper prototype rotate grace-delay, @zoe iterate empty-state copy, @design-bot provide aria snippets. Follow-up tomorrow. :thumbsup:
